title: No BacLock
text:
No BacLock. For years, Norwex has advertised that their microfiber bathroom products contain BacLock, which is a trademarked name for their exclusive silver-based antibacterial agent built into Norwex's microfiber products.

Unfortunately, this Norwex Bath Mat, which is quite expensive, and which is more towel-like than mat-like, does not contain BacLock.

product_metadata.title: Norwex Bath Mat - Graphite
description: Step out of the shower or bath onto the super-soft luxury of this highly absorbent microfiber mat.
